gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Admission is by committee evaluation of qualifications and exams; no prior supervisor agreement is mentioned.

funding.value: All admitted candidates receive a SISSA fellowship (EUR 1,120 net per month per the FAQ) for the whole course.
funding.quote: All admitted candidates will receive a fellowship of the amount of € 1.120,00 net per month.

entry_route.value: A Master's (or equivalent) degree is needed by the start of the course; a 4-year bachelor's is sometimes judged eligible by the Senate.
entry_route.quote: Yes you can, but you will have to obtain the Master degree (or equivalent) by the beginning of the courses.

also.quote: Usually a B.Sc. Hons. or a 4-year (or more) B.Sc. are sufficient.

notes: Own PhD course in the Physics Area; 2026/27 fellowships were FSE+ funded.
